notes.title: 0.895 Death Improvements, Balance Changes, Hit Feedback Improvements.
notes.notes:
[b]0.895 Death Improvements, Balance Changes, Hit Feedback Improvements.[/b]
- Fixed an issue where  zombie R swipes would sometimes be ineffective.
- Lowered ward repair soul reward, but you can now repair up to 24 ward parts in a round rather than 8.
- Added death animation.
- Added death music.
- Improved death sounds.
- Improved game over UI.
- Improved decapitation and decapitation hit registration from cantrips.
- Re-enabled cutting enemies in half with high damage attacks.
- Adjusted Round value calculation slightly.
- Adjusted goblin model/visuals.
- Increased enemy hit reaction physical effects.

notes.title: 0.87 Map Update. Movement Overhaul. Controller Improvements. Balance Changes.
notes.notes:
0.87 Map Update. Movement Overhaul. Controller Improvements. Balance Changes.
- Zombie spawn times rebalanced.
- Speed boost treasure is now diminishing and has lower base move speed increase.
- Burning effect deals less damage.
- Jump now imparts a small amount of speed in the direction you jump.
- Phase travels further if you are in the air.
- Sprint headbob updated.
- Sprint now lasts for less time, but recharges much faster.
- Jumping now 'consumes' stamina/sprint.
- Sprint now starts almost instantaneously.
- You can now animation cancel the part of the wind-down of the first attack of a melee weapon with sprint.
- Added seperate sensitivity slider for controllers.
- You can now scroll in the options menu with controller.
- Fixed an issue where projectiles would collide with mana and essence orbs.
- Fixed some Skeleton pathing issues.
- Mana gain is increased from soul boxes.
- Increased max spawned enemy count.
- Increased zombie attack wind up speed.
- Zombie speed calculation reworked. Slow + medium + fast zombies of different set speeds are now mixed in together at all rounds, with a gradual increase in speed types seen.
- If you take any damage while sprinting, you will now stop sprinting.
- Spell initial costs rebalanced (therefore scaling is also rebalanced), spell costs now are rounded to the nearest 50.
- Zombie general attack speeds increased.
- Health potion treasure added.
- Extensive visual improvements to Stronghold.
- Rocks/Props and other obstacles added nearby popular train spots.

notes.title: 0.832 Crash hotfix / other fixes.
notes.notes:
0.832 Crash hotfix / other fixes.
- Fixed a crash related to the reflect damage treasure.
- Fixed a bug where treasures would not persist after death on solo.
- Fixed the Engarde treasure not blocking correctly.
- Fixed a desync issue making clients unable to obtain new treasures.

notes.title: 0.823 - Hotfix - Leaderboard update.
notes.notes:
0.823: Hotfix
- Leaderboards now send updates every round, rather than only on the game over screen.
- Fix for rare crash.

notes.title: Demo 0.71 Update, New Cantrip, misc changes.
notes.notes:
Demo 0.71 Update, New Cantrip, misc changes.
- Added 'Splicer' cantrip to stronghold.
- Adjusted cantrip locations.
- Removed throwing axes from weapons chest (for now).
- Fixed pathing issue in cellar
- Removed grease repel treasure from loot table due to crash.
- Renamed durability to Essence & added extra tooltip.
- Lowered zombie health in early rounds.
- Lowered zombie speeds in early rounds.
- First skeleton now present in round 3 instead of 2.
- Fixed essence/durability pickups collision issue.

notes.title: 0.66, tutorial hotfix/improvements
notes.notes:
- Fixed some UI bugs
- Improvements and fixes for tutorial.

notes.title: Update 0.64, some small fixes & Changes.
notes.notes:
Update 0.64, some small fixes.
- Fixed attack animation issues in multiplayer for clients.
- Fixed tutorial text for first ward not correctly appearing.
- Heavy attacks can now once again be chained together.
- Upped heavy attack trigger time slightly to compensate for this.

notes.title: 0.63 Demo Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed inconsistent appid for version causing multiplayer issues.
- Updated animation sets slighly for weapons to encourage more fluidity when starting/ending attacks.
- Adjusted some weapon cleave values.
- Adjusted some weapon Attack Speeds
